title: Delta Review Engine v2 — Implementation Specification
purpose: Defines the executable delta review engine that compares item content hashes against the DELTA_LEDGER.json baseline, classifies change types, applies inheritance rules, and determines which items can skip re-review.

exports.computeContentHash(item): Returns SHA-256 hex string of canonical content fields
exports.computeMetadataHash(item): Returns SHA-256 hex string of metadata fields
exports.getReviewScope(changeClassification): Returns { boards, dimensions } — which review is needed
exports.applyInheritanceRules(identityKey, curre: Applies IR-001 through IR-005. Returns { action, inheritedState }

normalization_rules.whitespace: Trim leading/trailing. Collapse multiple consecutive spaces to single space.
normalization_rules.newlines_in_ec: Collapse multiple newlines to single newline. Do not remove single newlines.

hash_computation.field_hashes: Each field hashed independently for field-level diff capability.

FULL_CONTENT_CHANGE.trigger: Stem, any Choice, or CorrectChoice changed
FULL_CONTENT_CHANGE.review_scope: Full CAQS 10-dimension re-verification + all 5 G-NEW conditions

EXPLANATION_ONLY_CHANGE.review_scope: CAQS D1(correctness prong), D3(technical), D6(numerical), D7(explanation)

EC_PLUS_EW_CHANGE.trigger: EC + EW fields changed, Stem/Choices/CC unchanged

METADATA_CHANGED.label: Metadata Change — Partial Review Required
METADATA_CHANGED.review_scope: CAQS D1(blueprint prong), D2(cognitive), D9(accessibility), D10(metadata completeness). No technical re-review.
board_mapping: Quality Board B — psychometric + blueprint only

STRUCTURE_ONLY.label: Structural Fix Only — Verify, Don't Re-Review
STRUCTURE_ONLY.trigger: EW_Pattern changed (DL-008 clear, DL-026 fill) but EW text content unchanged for already-non-empty slots
STRUCTURE_ONLY.review_scope: Gate 1 re-scan to confirm defect resolution. No content board review needed.

UNCHANGED.label: Unchanged — Skip Review, Inherit Prior Certification
UNCHANGED.trigger: content_hash matches AND no new scan findings from pre-flight

NEW_ITEM.label: New Item — Full Pipeline Required
NEW_ITEM.trigger: identity_key not found in DELTA_LEDGER baseline (new QID or new variant)
NEW_ITEM.review_scope: Full pre-flight + Quality Board + Certification Board

IR_001.condition: content_hash matches baseline AND question_state was 'Certified' at baseline AND all pre-flight gates PASS on current pack file state
IR_001.action: Auto-inherit Certified status. Set question_state → 'CertifiedDelta'. No board review. DELTA_LEDGER records RECERTIFY entry with inherited=true.
IR_001.rationale: Item content is identical to last certification. Item is structurally clean. Re-review would add zero value.

IR_002.condition: Only EW fields changed (EW_Pattern different, EW text updated for non-CC slots). Stem/Choices/CC/EC unchanged. Gate 1 re-scan confirms all structural defects resolved.
IR_002.action: Verify EW text is non-boilerplate, choice-specific (Gate 2 scan). If PASS → auto-certify. If boilerplate detected → route to Content review.
IR_002.rationale: DL-008 clears and DL-026 fills are mechanical operations. Content review is only needed if boilerplate was introduced or persists.

IR_003.condition: content_hash matches but metadata_hash differs (difficulty recalibrated, cognitive level reassigned, LOSTag updated)
IR_003.action: Route to Psychometric Board only for metadata validation. No technical review. Auto-certify if metadata changes are internally consistent with CAQS targets.
IR_003.rationale: Difficulty recalibration doesn't invalidate answer-key correctness. Separate review path is sufficient.

IR_004.condition: content_hash differs AND Stem OR any Choice OR CorrectChoice changed
IR_004.action: question_state → 'In Audit'. Full CAQS 10-dimension re-verification. Prior certification decision retired.
IR_004.rationale: Changed stem = different question being asked. Changed answer key = prior certification invalid. Full re-audit required.

IR_005.condition: content_hash matches baseline BUT pre-flight scan detects a new defect that wasn't present at last certification (e.g., Gate 1 scan now detects DL-008 on previously-clean item)
IR_005.action: Override IR-001. Route to REMEDIATE. Do not inherit. Item must be remediated before recertification.
IR_005.rationale: Even with unchanged content, a newly-detected structural defect (from improved scan methodology or regression) must be resolved before learner delivery.

review_scope_determination.description: Maps change classification to exact CAQS dimensions and board assignments needed for re-review.

session_t0: 2. For each item in current pack files: compute content_hash + metadata_hash via AM-1 extraction
4. If found → classify change (compare hashes). If not found → classify as NEW_ITEM.
6. Produce delta_manifest: { per_item: { skip, reason, review_scope }, aggregate: { skipCount, reviewCount, newCount } }
7. Quality Board receives review-scoped items only
session_writes: After any content change: new content_hash written to DELTA_LEDGER with new VersionID
DELTA_LEDGER entry records: old_hash → new_hash, change_type, changed_fields, session_id
Registry updated with new VersionID + new content_hash
